thesis: Machine-proposed candidate (app.evolution). Tests a 13/21-day EMA crossover trigger inside a 135-day SMA regime filter on CSCO, AMAT, LRCX, KLAC, INTU, IGV, with a 8% stop and a 93-session time stop. Never scored before being written -- this is falsified if the crossover-inside-regime signal fails to beat this purpose's benchmark by more than the measured ordering-noise floor, across whatever windows it is actually run against.
entry: close > sma(135) and ema(13) crosses_above ema(21)
